data.title: Opinion: Nvidia’s $500B private equity AI funding deal isn’t a good sign
data.description: We’ve been told it’s not a bubble. We’ve been told this is nothing like the Dot Com bust. To be fair, there are substantive differences. | Nvidia’s $500B AI financing push is fueling fresh bubble fears, exposing how much of the AI infrastructure boom may depend on circular deals, shaky demand and scarce power.
